issues.description: First URL entry manually prepends gh-proxy.com mirror prefix (https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/ngtcp2/nghttp3/...). Per R39, CI automatically adds mirror fallbacks (gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub) for GitHub URLs; conandata.yml should only contain the official source URL without manual mirror prefixes. The official GitHub URL is correctly present as the second entry (line 7), making the first entry redundant and non-compliant.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the gh-proxy.com URL entry (line 6). Keep only the official GitHub URL (line 7). CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks at build time when the official URL is unreachable.

issues.description: Status inconsistency within notes.md: the compilation environment section states '状态: published' (line 7) but the final status at the bottom says '**最终状态**: built' (line 45). manifest.yaml (both version-level and software-level) declares status as 'published'. Per review_memory rule 3, 'published' means CI upload succeeded and 'built' means verified but not uploaded. If the package was only built locally and not uploaded to the artifact repo, marking it as 'published' would be inaccurate. The internal inconsistency should be resolved to ensure truthful status reporting.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify the actual CI upload status. If CI upload succeeded, update notes.md bottom line to 'published'. If only built locally, update manifest.yaml and README.md status to 'built'. The status must be consistent across all files.

issues.description: patch_description does not follow the '0001 xxx' format convention. Code style rule 12 specifies the description should start with the patch number prefix, e.g., '0001 Add HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony platform detection to config.guess'. Current value omits the '0001' prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update patch_description to '0001 Add HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony platform detection to config.guess' to match the convention where the patch number prefixes the description.

issues.description: 'import os' on line 9 is unused in active code. It is only referenced in a commented-out alternative line (line 33: '# self.run(f"{os.path.join(...)}"...)'). Unused imports should be removed for code cleanliness per code style rule 16 (import ordering/cleanliness).
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import os' from line 9. If the alternative direct binary execution approach is desired in the future, the import can be re-added at that time.

summary: Audit of nghttp3 1.15.0 Conan recipe for HarmonyOS PC platform (branch feat/nghttp3-1.15.0). 10 changed files reviewed against code_style and review_memory rules. VERDICT: PASS. No P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness) issues found. Deception checks all passed: (1) R34 - test_package/test.c calls real nghttp3 API functions nghttp3_version(0) and nghttp3_settings_default(&settings) with proper NULL checks, version mismatch verification, and settings field access — not an empty shell test. (2) R9 - test_package/conanfile.py calls cmake.test() without skipping or faking pass. (3) sha256 '0e431c81eb2d3df5ced048d6e942925ff922ad053e76a0274eea7b164c9b776e' is a valid 64-character hex hash, not fake. (4) No #ifdef __OHOS__ empty stubs. (5) No precompiled binaries in PR. Correctness checks all passed: conanfile.py uses Conan 2.x API (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.cmake), proper shebang and docstring, PascalCase class name Nghttp3Conan, correct method ordering (export_sources→requirements→layout→source→generate→build→package→package_info), package_info sets cpp_info.libs. No hardcoded shell env vars (R33 satisfied). No OHOS platform check needed (R32 N/A). Version strategy correct for first adaptation using upstream version 1.15.0 (R37 satisfied). nghttp3 is not a system library name so R26 static linking N/A. Official GitHub URL present (R39 satisfied, minor mirror prefix issue). Four minor issues found: (1) P2-R39 manual gh-proxy.com mirror prefix in conandata.yml URL list should be removed; (2) P2 status inconsistency in notes.md between 'published' and 'built' needs clarification; (3) P3 patch_description missing '0001' number prefix; (4) P3 unused 'import os' in test_package/conanfile.py. Note: url='' in conanfile.py is intentionally empty by design (CI fills automatically) and was not flagged per task instructions.
